sources.excerpt: Violet Menace – Stomp Under Foot Skip to content Search Search Cart PRODUCTS CONTACT FAQ DEALERS ARTISTS ABOUT BLOG Skip to product information Previous Next Close VIOLET MENACE RAM'S HEAD® Regular price $204.99 By Stomp Under Foot Quantity Add to cart Inspired by one of the most popular circuits of the early 1970s, the Violet Ram’s Head, the Violet Menace has an added mids control that expands your tonal options while preserving the character of the original circuit. For that classic scooped-mid sound, use the Ram’s Head symbol on the mids control as your starting point. It marks the approximate setting for the original circuit’s mids. Turn the mids control up from the symbol to add mids for a fuller sound that cuts through a live band mix, or turn it down for a deeper scoop. The marked setting gets you very close to the original sound, with small adjustments to the mids and tone controls helping you dial it in. The mids and tone controls work together, giving you plenty of room to explore and create your own sound. The overall tone of the Violet Menace is balanced and smooth, delivering rich harmonics, singing sustain, punchy chords, and articulate lead tones. The Violet Menace combines vintage-inspired fuzz with the flexibility to make it your own. Stomp Under Foot Stomp Under Foot Big Muff versions browse by type distortion/fuzz/overdrive fuzz browse by enclosure pedal Stomp Under Foot Violet Menace Published on July 31, 2014 Stomp Under Foot Big Muff versions fuzz pedal mini mini Information Stomp Under Foot The Violet Menace is based on the regular version of the Stomp Under Foot Ram's Head but has the added mids control. Many of you are familiar with the Ram's Head and it's very balanced and smooth tone. When you have this type of tone sound, just adding mids makes it brighter and you lose some of the character. With some slight modifications, I made sure that the original character of the pedal stayed intact while adding the mids. What you get is that Ram's Head tone with mids while still retaining the punch of the lower strings and the smooth, singing tone on leads. I hope you guys like it as much as I do.
